title: JetBrains/thinkrail: a small IDE built around the pi agent
friendlyTitle: ThinkRail: JetBrains' small editor built around the pi agent
summary: ThinkRail gained 1,156 stars today on GitHub's daily trending list, the most of any new JetBrains repo there, and now has about 2,700. It is an Apache-2.0 IDE, in the browser and as a desktop app, built around the pi coding agent rather than around a JetBrains language plugin.
friendlySummary: ThinkRail gained 1,156 stars today on GitHub's daily trending list, and now has about 2,700. It is a free IDE, in the browser and as a desktop app, built around the pi coding agent rather than around a JetBrains language plugin. The licence is Apache 2.0.
whyItMatters: If you already work in pi, ThinkRail is a place to keep the files, the diffs, the specs, and the model picker in one window, including on an Intel Mac as of today's desktop build. You still bring your own model provider. It is not a hosted agent, and it is not a substitute for reading the diff before you merge.
